groups.name: Blocked by something outside this repository
groups.lede: Work that cannot proceed from here, whatever effort is applied. Each one names what would unblock it.

items.title: Evidence verification has never run
items.blocker: The build environment has no access to PubMed, Cochrane, NICE, any journal or any textbook. Agent 2 of the three agent pipeline is the fact checker and it cannot retrieve a single source.
items.needed: Source access, or a human verifier. Until then no page on this site carries a reference, every verified handoff is marked NOT_RUN_TOOLS_UNAVAILABLE, and no citation has been invented to fill the gap.

items.title: Consultant review has no return path
items.blocker: Review packs are written to docs/review/ and there is no mechanism for a consultant to return a decision into the pipeline. The deployed design uses a Step Functions task token, and the pipeline is not deployed.
items.needed: Either the pipeline deployed to an AWS account, or an agreed manual route for returning review decisions.

items.title: The sgit.ai deployment workflow was never read
items.blocker: https://sgit.ai/llms.txt returns 403 at the network egress gateway. The host is not on the allow list for this environment.
items.needed: Either the document contents pasted into the chat, or the host allowed through the environment's network policy.
